verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents versioning, branches, and reviews for documentation content, and it ships automation-like features such as the GitHub AI Writer and Linter rules. The evidence never shows that these automations can themselves be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Content versioning and review is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
